description: Payment Verify: did this x402 payment really settle on Base? Send the tx hash or the seller's PAYMENT-RESPONSE header; get SETTLED / MISMATCH / PENDING / FAILED / NOT_FOUND with payer, payee, USDC amount, block, confirmations and time, checked against the payee/amount you expected. Proof for disputes, refunds and books. Public chain data, never needs a key. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/pay/verify, $0.002 via x402.)

expected_pay_to.description: payout wallet you expect (0x...), to catch swapped payees
